approval_required.basis: Requiring an approved change request is the core of change control.
approval_required.name: Configuration Change Control

approval_required.basis: An unapproved production change by an agent needs human sign-off.
approval_required.name: Human oversight

approval_required.basis: Deploying without approval is excessive agency.
approval_required.name: Excessive Agency

approval_required.basis: an unapproved production change maps to system-process modification / persistence
approval_required.name: Create or Modify System Process

beneficiary_unverified.basis: Paying only verified beneficiaries enforces who the agent may transact with.
beneficiary_unverified.name: Access Enforcement

beneficiary_unverified.basis: Acting on unverified counterparty data is a data-governance failure.
beneficiary_unverified.name: Data and data governance

beneficiary_unverified.basis: Sending funds to an unverified party is acting beyond safe authority.
beneficiary_unverified.name: Excessive Agency

beneficiary_unverified.basis: acting on behalf of an unverified party is valid-account abuse
beneficiary_unverified.name: Valid Accounts

change_freeze_active.basis: Honoring a change freeze is configuration change control.
change_freeze_active.name: Configuration Change Control

change_freeze_active.basis: A freeze restricts who/when changes may be applied.
change_freeze_active.name: Access Restrictions for Change

change_freeze_active.basis: Deploying during a freeze is acting beyond authority.
change_freeze_active.name: Excessive Agency

change_freeze_active.basis: a destructive change during a freeze maps to data destruction
change_freeze_active.name: Data Destruction

classification_above_ceiling.basis: Refusing to handle data above a classification ceiling enforces the categorization of the resource.
classification_above_ceiling.name: Security Categorization

classification_above_ceiling.basis: The ceiling governs the flow of classified information through the agent.
classification_above_ceiling.name: Information Flow Enforcement

classification_above_ceiling.basis: Handling over-classified data is a data-governance violation.
classification_above_ceiling.name: Data and data governance

classification_above_ceiling.basis: Processing restricted data above ceiling risks sensitive-information disclosure.
classification_above_ceiling.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure

classification_above_ceiling.basis: handling data above a classification ceiling maps to sensitive-data access
classification_above_ceiling.name: Data from Cloud Storage

dual_control_required.basis: Dual control is the textbook separation-of-duties control: no single actor (here, one agent) completes a sensitive transaction alone.
dual_control_required.name: Separation of Duties

dual_control_required.basis: A high-value financial action by an automated system requires effective human oversight before it takes effect.
dual_control_required.name: Human oversight

dual_control_required.basis: An agent moving money without a second authorizer is the canonical excessive-agency failure.
dual_control_required.name: Excessive Agency

dual_control_required.basis: Risk treatment: enforce a control commensurate with transaction risk.
dual_control_required.name: Manage function

dual_control_required.basis: separation of duties mitigates valid-account / privilege abuse
dual_control_required.name: Valid Accounts

high_blast_needs_named_approver.basis: A high blast-radius change requires an impact analysis and an accountable approver.
high_blast_needs_named_approver.name: Impact Analyses

high_blast_needs_named_approver.basis: A named approver distinct from the actor is separation of duties.
high_blast_needs_named_approver.name: Separation of Duties

high_blast_needs_named_approver.basis: High-impact automated changes require a named human owner.
high_blast_needs_named_approver.name: Human oversight

high_blast_needs_named_approver.basis: a high blast-radius destructive change maps to inhibit-system-recovery
high_blast_needs_named_approver.name: Inhibit System Recovery

human_review_required.basis: An adverse automated decision affecting a person requires human oversight before it is issued.
human_review_required.name: Human oversight

human_review_required.basis: Issuing an adverse decision with no human in the loop is excessive agency.
human_review_required.name: Excessive Agency

human_review_required.basis: Adverse outcomes are a measured risk requiring a treatment (human review).
human_review_required.name: Measure function

human_review_required.basis: autonomous execution without oversight maps to command/scripting abuse
human_review_required.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter

out_of_scope_domain.basis: Restricting the agent to in-scope resources is least privilege.
out_of_scope_domain.name: Least Privilege

out_of_scope_domain.basis: Scope is enforced at access time.
out_of_scope_domain.name: Access Enforcement

out_of_scope_domain.basis: Reaching outside authorized scope is excessive agency.
out_of_scope_domain.name: Excessive Agency

out_of_scope_domain.basis: reaching outside authorized scope maps to account/privilege manipulation
out_of_scope_domain.name: Account Manipulation

over_threshold.basis: A transaction-value ceiling is an access-enforcement rule on what the agent is permitted to execute.
over_threshold.name: Access Enforcement

over_threshold.basis: The agent is granted only the transaction authority it needs; amounts above the limit exceed that grant.
over_threshold.name: Least Privilege

over_threshold.basis: Above-threshold value should escalate to a human rather than auto-execute.
over_threshold.name: Human oversight

over_threshold.basis: Unbounded transaction authority is excessive agency.
over_threshold.name: Excessive Agency

over_threshold.basis: a transaction-value ceiling bounds valid-account authority
over_threshold.name: Valid Accounts

regulated_egress_blocked.basis: Blocking export to an out-of-scope endpoint is information-flow enforcement.
regulated_egress_blocked.name: Information Flow Enforcement

regulated_egress_blocked.basis: Preventing data leaving the controlled boundary is boundary protection.
regulated_egress_blocked.name: Boundary Protection

regulated_egress_blocked.basis: Uncontrolled egress of regulated data is a data-governance failure.
regulated_egress_blocked.name: Data and data governance

regulated_egress_blocked.basis: Egress of regulated records is sensitive-information disclosure.
regulated_egress_blocked.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure

regulated_egress_blocked.basis: Data leaving to an external domain maps to the Exfiltration tactic; confirm the specific technique with an analyst.
regulated_egress_blocked.name: Exfiltration

regulated_egress_blocked.basis: uncontrolled egress of regulated data maps to exfiltration
regulated_egress_blocked.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol

confirm_note: Proposed CWN mappings, confidence-tagged. Confirm against the current published control text before relying on them for audit. Enterprise control ids are mapped at onboarding by your GRC team, never auto-asserted.
description: Canonical deny-reasons mapped 1:1 to well-established framework controls. A source-named reason here is ASSERTED (auditable). The heuristics map a verb-named action to a reason when none is declared (INFERRED).
